entities.summary: Julius Babatunde Adelakun was a Nigerian Roman Catholic prelate, who served as Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Oyo. He retired from active service in 2009 and was succeeded by Emmanuel Adetoyese Badejo, the present Bishop of Oyo. Adelakun died on 24 October 2025, at the age of 90.
